Poles of order m >= 2 (secondary balances, v'''' not dominant): none if a1 != 0; if a1 = 0 != c4000: only m = 2 with a = -(4a2+6a3)/c4000; if a1 = c4000 = 0: m >= 2 needs (m+1) a3 + m a2 = 0 or a2 = a3 = 0 and then the next level (list of NEWTON, note 1.4). 4 is an index at every simple-pole balance iff a2 = 2 a3 iff the core is the derivative of a third-order core. After scaling a balance to a = 1: v'''' - Core = R''' + al v R'' + be v' R' + ga v'' R + t R R', R = v' + v^2 (card Q41B-RESONANCE-MAP).
